name: Survey tile in Virgo
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 3.8 degrees north of the ecliptic in Virgo, imaged by SPHEREx 20 times in 6 visits over 69 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 32 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.9 days starting 2025-06-16, at wavelengths from 0.85 to 4.98 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
